name: Karakeep
short_desc: Self-hostable bookmark/notes/images app with AI tagging and iOS + Android apps
author: karakeep-app
description: Karakeep (formerly Hoarder) is a self-hostable bookmark-everything app: save links, notes, images, and PDFs, with optional AI auto-tagging. Includes native iOS and Android apps that connect to your server, plus Chrome/Firefox/Safari extensions. Capture from the share sheet on iOS, tag and search later, keep historical notes on products you liked, restaurants worth returning to, etc.

form_fields.label: Ollama Base URL
form_fields.hint: Optional: point at your local Ollama (e.g. http://100.126.40.64:11434) for local AI tagging. Leave blank to disable AI tagging or use OpenAI only.

form_fields.label: Disable Signups
form_fields.hint: Set to 'true' after creating your account to block new registrations.
